title: Free security check response (200 of POST /scan and GET /scan/{token})
description: Wraps the report so that the site token never becomes part of it: a client may keep and show the report, but must keep the token secret.

site_token.description: Secret token of the site, only in the response of the POST /scan that registered or re-registered the site. The client keeps it, sends it as Authorization: Bearer, and never shows or logs it. The server keeps only its SHA-256 hash.
